name: run_claude_pilot
description: Dispatch a headless Claude Code implementation session via claude-pilot. Long-running — returns a task ID immediately, results arrive via callback when Claude Code finishes.

skill.description: Which skill prompt to run. Currently only 'dev-pilot' (implementation dispatch).

prompt.description: Issue reference in repo#number format (e.g., 'mika#214', 'mika-skills#8'). The handler derives the branch, creates a worktree, and runs the /mika pipeline. For free-text prompts, pass a plain string — sent to claude-pilot as-is without worktree setup.

task_id.description: The UUID returned by create_task (36-char format like '15383984-a3e7-41bf-ac6f-630ba9a89d63'). Used for log filename and task correlation at /var/log/claude-pilot/{task_id}.log. Do NOT pass issue references (e.g., 'mika-284') — pass the task UUID.

iteration_context.description: Iteration feedback for an existing PR. When present alongside a repo#number prompt, appended to the prompt so the /mika pipeline addresses specific feedback rather than re-implementing from scratch.
